candidates.change_summary: Change the timing check from strict to non-strict: block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block, allowing settlement one block earlier.
Compute the answer from blockhash(block.number) instead of blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block), changing the winning condition.
Invert the winning comparison to guess != answer so the payout goes to non-matching guesses.
Change the balance requirement from >= 2 ether to > 2 ether, making settlement revert when the balance is exactly 2 ether.
Delete the reset statement guesses[msg.sender].block = 0; so a settled guess remains and settle() can succeed repeatedly instead of reverting on subsequent calls.
